concepts.quote: Yes, those are the page ranks; the simulation counted every move.
concepts.why: Treats the 100-move frequencies as the exact page ranks, the listed wrong rule that a short simulation gives the exact ranks rather than an estimate freq[i]/T.
The answer says nothing about the power method or about whether the start page matters.
Uses counting every move as proof the printed values are exact, which is the wrong rule that a short simulation gives the exact page ranks; the start-page question is left unanswered.
